Container.Name: linkwarden-mcp
Container.Overview: Linkwarden MCP Server (Streamable HTTP). Exposes a Linkwarden instance to MCP clients. Point clients at http://[IP]:[PORT:8080]/mcp, or front it with the reverse proxy for remote access from Claude.

Config.Name: Port 8095
Config.Description: Host port for the MCP endpoint. Only the host side varies; the container always listens on 8080, so leave MCP_PORT alone when changing this.

Config.Name: LINKWARDEN_BASE_URL
Config.Description: URL of your Linkwarden instance, no trailing slash.

Config.Name: TOOLSETS
Config.Description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable: search, collection, link, tags. Empty enables all.

Config.Name: READ_ONLY
Config.Description: Set true to disable every write tool (create/delete/archive).

Config.Name: MCP_PORT
Config.Description: Port inside the container. Must match the container side of the port mapping above.

Config.Name: MCP_OAUTH_ENABLED
Config.Description: Set true to require OAuth 2.1 bearer tokens. Leave false only if the endpoint is not reachable from the internet.

Config.Name: MCP_OAUTH_ISSUER
Config.Description: OIDC provider URL. Must match the issuer the provider reports exactly, trailing slash included.

Config.Name: MCP_SERVER_URL
Config.Description: Public base URL this server is reached on, e.g. https://linkwarden-mcp.example.com. No path.

Config.Name: MCP_READ_GROUPS
Config.Description: Comma-separated IdP groups granted read tools only. Empty disables group checking.

Config.Name: MCP_WRITE_GROUPS
Config.Description: Comma-separated IdP groups granted every tool. Empty disables group checking.

Config.Name: MCP_GROUPS_CLAIM
Config.Description: Token claim holding the caller's groups.
